# MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01

Scope
- This document describes lubrication and hydraulic oil replacement activities for EQ-P3-L1-HP01.  
- Applicability: maintenance personnel performing fluid service and verification.  
- Related documents: MM-P3-L1-HP01, SOP-P3-L1-02, SOP-P3-L1-03

Tools
- Approved oil transfer pump compatible with CFW-LUB-927.  
- Clean, lint-free containers and funnels.  
- Absorbent pads and drip containment.  
- Paperwork and tagout supplies per SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-03.

Procedure
- Prepare equipment for service per SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-03, including lockout and verification steps.  
- Position drip containment beneath reservoir and lines.  
- Drain reservoir to approved waste container following shop hazardous waste procedures referenced in MM-P3-L1-HP01.  
- Inspect reservoir and sight glasses for contamination and debris; remove foreign material with clean, lint-free cloths.  
- Refill reservoir with lubricant part number CFW-LUB-927 using approved transfer pump and contamination-control practices.  
- Cycle the system using controls described in MM-P3-L1-HP01 to purge air from lines and verify flow.  
- Check for visible leaks at fittings and seals after refill, and secure any loose connections per SOP-P3-L1-02.  
- Record oil change in equipment log and maintenance records, and attach waste disposal documentation per MM-P3-L1-HP01.

Acceptance criteria
- System operates without visible leaks and fluid level is within manufacturer sight glass range after purge.  
- No abnormal noises or visible air entrainment in reservoir during steady-state operation.  
- Maintenance records updated and waste disposal paperwork filed in accordance with MM-P3-L1-HP01.  
- The hydraulic oil change interval for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 2425 hours; next due date entered into maintenance schedule.
